Man performs black magic ritual with Chief Justice's photo in cremation ground

A man was apprehended by police in Bilaspur for performing a black magic ritual in a cremation ground. The ritual involved the photograph of the Chhattisgarh High Court's Chief Justice, along with dead fish, lemons, and vermilion. The accused claimed he was performing the ritual for bail. A video of the incident went viral, causing alarm in the area.
